## FIELD transaction

<!-- FIELD-TRANSACTION
authority-owner: public-runtime
surface: <native-head-or-hard-domain>
class: DELTA
publication: public-native
return: </returns/... or NONE>
stop: <exact condition that ends this move>
-->

### SOURCE
What current head/source owns this change? Name exact evidence or route.

### HOLD
What one object/function is being changed? What remains explicitly out of scope?

### TURN
What is the smallest functional delta?

### TRACE
What machine-verifiable evidence proves or falsifies it? Name any irreducible human/device/world property separately.

### RETURN
What exact native owner receives the result? What is the next default after RETURN? (Normally NONE until replanned.)

### Cross-repo boundary
- Private source used: none / scrubbed promotion / reference only
- No private fixtures, credentials, personal context, or unpublished source are copied into this public PR.
- If another open PR owns the same hard surface, stop and converge there rather than opening parallel truth.
